verdict.rationale: Omarchy provides a keyboard-driven 'Install' menu (e.g., Install > Development) for setting up apps/environments, and community reports confirm it ships with and can install popular apps (Zoom, Spotify, Steam, Minecraft) easily and quickly, but this is a terminal/menu-driven installer rather than a dedicated visual 'app store' with single-click browsing. Missing for 10: an actual app-store UI/catalog with visual browsing, explicit 'single-click' install confirmation, and coverage beyond dev tools/known bundled apps.
